chapter four · from me to you

Things I hope
you always remember.

Golu,

Happy 18th birthday to my favourite person. I hope this new chapter of your life brings you so many reasons to smile, so much peace, so many adventures, and all the things your heart quietly wishes for.

I hope you never lose that cute, shy, fun, teasing, mastikhor side of you. I hope you keep laughing at your own nonsense, keep dreaming big, and keep being the person who makes ordinary days feel a little more special.

Thank you for being you. For the little moments, the laughs, the comfort, and for becoming such an important part of my life. I may tease you a lot, but underneath every bit of it is so much love and softness for you.

And if life ever gets hard, I hope you remember how loved you are. Not just on birthdays. Not just when everything is going perfectly. Always.
